name: headroom-macos
title_zh: 菜单栏订阅余量仪表盘，四家 AI 一眼看完
tagline_zh: 装一次，菜单栏常驻四家 AI 的剩余额度。不用开网页、不用记密码，点一下看 token 和请求数还剩多少。
tagline_en: One install, four AI quotas live in your menu bar. No browser, no password juggling—click to see tokens and.
desc_en: Native SwiftUI rules for Headroom, a macOS menu-bar app that shows Grok, Claude, OpenAI/Codex, and Cursor subscription quotas. Use when editing Headroom, MenuBarExtra, provider adapters, popover meters, tokens, Keychain or CLI credential reads, or when the user runs /headroom-macos.
why_zh: 原生 SwiftUI 写死，不吃 Electron 内存；Keychain 直读凭证。
why_en: Native SwiftUI, not Electron bloat. Reads credentials via Keychain—no plaintext keys in config files.
limit_zh: 只做订阅额度展示，不含用量统计、计费预测或跨账号汇总。需自行在 Keychain 存好各服务凭证。
limit_en: Shows quotas only—no usage history, cost forecasts, or multi-account rollups. Requires credentials pre-stored in Keychain; macOS menu bar only.
title_en: Menu-bar quota gauges for Grok, Claude, OpenAI & Cursor
